sql: select 'new_orders' as what, coalesce(status,'-') as k, count(*)::text as v from live_orders where strategy='Emmsell10' and created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 23:51:41+00' group by status union all select 'new_orders_first_at','-', coalesce(min(created_at)::text,'none') from live_orders where strategy='Emmsell10' and created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 23:51:41+00' union all select 'funnel', se.created_at::text, concat('E=', coalesce(se.raw_json->'per_book'->>'Emmsell10','-'), ' opened=', se.raw_json->>'opened', ' contestcap=', se.raw_json->>'skipped_contest_cap') from system_events se where se.component='mmsell_scan' and se.created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 23:51:41+00'
